name: PixelcraftDev Addons for Elementor (Lite)
author: superauu

sections.description:
A comprehensive collection of creative and professional widgets for Elementor. Enhance your website building experience with high-quality widgets.

External services

The Social Share widget (includes/widgets/class-social-share-widget.php) integrates with the WhatsApp share endpoint at api.whatsapp.com when the WhatsApp option is used.

When a visitor clicks the WhatsApp share button, the plugin sends:
* The current page title
* The current page URL

WhatsApp legal documents:
* Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
* Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pixelcraftdev-addons-for-elementor-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the PixelcraftDev category in the Elementor editor to add widgets to your pages.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor Free?

Yes, it works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Is it mobile friendly?

Absolutely! All widgets are fully responsive and mobile-optimized.
